name: James Monroe
desc: president of the United States from 1817 to 1825 (1758–1831)

offices.t: United States Ambassador to the United Kingdom

summary: James Monroe (April 28, 1758 – July 4, 1831) was a Founding Father and the fifth president of the United States, serving from 1817 to 1825. He was the last Founding Father to serve as president. A member of the Democratic-Republican Party, his presidency coincided with the Era of Good Feelings, in which the First Party System of American politics ended with the collapse of the Federalist Party.
